description: Source code implementing functions for translating and processing CSI-RS (Channel State Information Reference Signal) PDUs in a 5G NR context, including conversion from FAPI format to physical layer structures and pattern extraction.

methods.name: translate_amplitude
methods.description: Converts a power_control_offset_ss enum value to a linear amplitude.

methods.name: convert_csi_rs_fapi_to_phy
methods.description: Converts a FAPI CSI-RS PDU to a physical layer configuration structure.

methods.name: get_csi_rs_pattern_from_fapi_pdu
methods.description: Extracts and constructs a CSI-RS pattern from a FAPI PDU.
